question: arXiv API 检索的延迟 T_retrieval 和召回率 Recall@10 需实测：在 100 个指定研究方向的测试集中，若 T_retrieval > 2s 或 Recall@10 < 70%，则需切换至更快速的向量检索后端或优化查询重写策略。

sources.title: arXiv API User's Manual - arXiv info
sources.snippet: arXiv API User's Manual provides guidance on using arXiv's API for accessing and managing academic research data efficiently.

sources.title: arXiv API Access - arXiv info
sources.snippet: Do not brand your project with arXiv's names ("arXiv", "arXiv.org", "arXiv Labs", "arXivLabs") or use associated logos, web addresses, and colors in a manner that implies arXiv's endorsement of the project. Check out the arXiv API user community to learn, ask questions, and share information about your project.
